body: Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense said on the morning of November 5 that, in the 24 hours from 6 a.m. on November 4 to 6 a.m. on November 5, it detected 8 PLA warships, 8 government vessels and 21 PLA aircraft sorties, of which 19 aircraft crossed the Taiwan Strait median line and entered airspace north, central, southwest and east of Taiwan.
The ministry said the armed forces monitored the activity closely and responded with mission aircraft and vessels as well as land-based missile systems.
en.summary: Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense said it detected 8 PLA warships, 8 government vessels and 21 PLA aircraft sorties in the 24 hours to 6 a.m. on November 5, with 19 aircraft crossing the Taiwan Strait median line; the military said it monitored and responded with mission aircraft, vessels and land-based missile systems.
en.title: 21 PLA aircraft and 8 warships detected near Taiwan; military monitoring closely

facts.claim: From 6 a.m. on November 4 to 6 a.m. on November 5, Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense detected 8 PLA warships, 8 government vessels and 21 PLA aircraft sorties.
Of the 21 aircraft sorties, 19 crossed the Taiwan Strait median line and entered airspace north, central, southwest and east of Taiwan.
The ministry said the armed forces monitored the activity closely and responded with mission aircraft and vessels as well as land-based missile systems.

body: 國防部5日上午公布共機艦動態，統計自4日上午6時起至5日上午6時止，偵獲8艘共艦、8艘公務船及21架次共機，其中19架次共機逾越台灣海峽中線，侵擾北部、中部、西南及東部空域。
國防部強調，國軍運用任務機艦及岸置飛彈系統嚴密監控與應處。
zh.summary: 國防部公布最新共機艦動態，自11月4日上午6時至11月5日上午6時，偵獲8艘共艦、8艘公務船及21架次共機，其中19架次逾越台海中線，國軍運用任務機艦及岸置飛彈系統嚴密監控應處。
zh.title: 共機21架次擾台、19架次越中線，國軍嚴密監控
